```{r}
# =======================================================
# Problem 5: Overall Percentage of Relevant Images (Law of Total Probability)
# =======================================================

# Define the percentage of images supplied by each sensor (Prior probabilities)
P_Sensor <- c(0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.40)

# Define the percentage of relevant images given each sensor (Conditional probabilities)
P_Relevant_given_Sensor <- c(0.50, 0.60, 0.80, 0.85)

# Calculate the overall probability of a relevant image (Total Probability)
P_Relevant_total <- sum(P_Sensor * P_Relevant_given_Sensor)

# Convert to percentage
overall_percentage <- P_Relevant_total * 100

cat("--- Problem 5 Result ---\n")
cat("The overall percentage of relevant images is:", overall_percentage, "%\n\n")


# =======================================================
# Problem 6: Pairwise vs. Mutual Independence of Coin Tosses
# =======================================================

# Define the sample space for tossing a fair coin twice
sample_space <- c("HH", "HT", "TH", "TT")
P_each <- 1 / length(sample_space) # Each outcome has a 1/4 probability

# Define the events as logical vectors over the sample space
E1 <- sample_space %in% c("HH", "TT")
E2 <- sample_space %in% c("HH", "HT")
E3 <- sample_space %in% c("TH", "HH")

# Compute individual probabilities
P_E1 <- sum(E1 * P_each)
P_E2 <- sum(E2 * P_each)
P_E3 <- sum(E3 * P_each)

# Compute intersection probabilities
P_E1_and_E2 <- sum((E1 & E2) * P_each)
P_E1_and_E3 <- sum((E1 & E3) * P_each)
P_E2_and_E3 <- sum((E2 & E3) * P_each)
P_E1_E2_E3  <- sum((E1 & E2 & E3) * P_each)

cat("--- Problem 6 Verification ---\n")

# Check Pairwise Independence: P(A ∩ B) == P(A) * P(B)
cat("1. Pairwise Independence Checks:\n")
cat("   P(E1 ∩ E2) =", P_E1_and_E2, "| P(E1) * P(E2) =", P_E1 * P_E2, 
    "-> Independent?", P_E1_and_E2 == (P_E1 * P_E2), "\n")
cat("   P(E1 ∩ E3) =", P_E1_and_E3, "| P(E1) * P(E3) =", P_E1 * P_E3, 
    "-> Independent?", P_E1_and_E3 == (P_E1 * P_E3), "\n")
cat("   P(E2 ∩ E3) =", P_E2_and_E3, "| P(E2) * P(E3) =", P_E2 * P_E3, 
    "-> Independent?", P_E2_and_E3 == (P_E2 * P_E3), "\n\n")

# Check Mutual Independence: P(E1 ∩ E2 ∩ E3) == P(E1) * P(E2) * P(E3)
cat("2. Mutual Independence Check:\n")
cat("   P(E1 ∩ E2 ∩ E3) =", P_E1_E2_E3, "| P(E1) * P(E2) * P(E3) =", P_E1 * P_E2 * P_E3, 
    "-> Mutually Independent?", P_E1_E2_E3 == (P_E1 * P_E2 * P_E3), "\n")
```
